batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c A Chopra b BAW Mendis

batting.name: Salman Butt
batting.dismissal: c TM Srivastava b S Sreesanth

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b PP Chawla

batting.name: A Chopra
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b JR Hopes

batting.name: Umar Gul
batting.dismissal: c RR Powar b VRV Singh

balls.text: no hat-trick unfortunately for Gul, he bowls a low full toss and he gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to punch it straight, he manages a single anyway
Gul's hit the furniture again! Chawla makes room to steer it wide of the keeper and down to third man, the ball removes the offstump and pegs the middle stump back
Pathan makes room and slog it over the on side, Gul fires in a yorker at the base of the stumps and flattens the off and middle stumps as Pathan heaves and misses
Dropped: Pathan pulls a slow bouncer and gets a thick top edge, Ishant runs backwards from short fine leg but loses sight of the ball as it swirls in the air, he spills the catch
follows it up with another unplayable yorker, he makes room and edges it onto his boot, they scamper a single this time
he sees him make room and fires in the yorker outside leg, he can only dig it out back to the bowler
that's slightly short outside the offstump, Pathan makes a bit of room and punches it wide of extra cover
full on middle and leg, he works it to long-on
makes room, he follows the batsman and fires a yorker outside leg, he squeezes it out and the ball lobs behind the stumps, Saha's throw misses the stumps this time
full outside off, he pushes to long-off

the slower ball, Jayawardene shapes to pull but he's too early on the stroke, the ball lobs off his body and rolls to the keeper, they set off for the run but the direct hit by Saha at the striker's end finds Yuvraj well short of his ground
fires it full on the pads, he shuffles and works it wide of midwicket
walks across his stumps to paddle it fine but the slower ball foxes him

makes room for himself and Ishant fires it full and slightly wide outside off, Jayawardene shapes to squeeze it past cover but opens the face of the bat and steers it towards third man, that was good improvisation
makes room to a pitched up delivery and carves it over extra cover, that was too easy for Mahela
makes room for himself and sort of mistimes the drive to long-off
slides on the pads and he works it behind the wicket and places it wide of short fine leg, that ball raced away
loses his line and slides it well wide outside the offstump, it was also a full toss

sloppy! The dropped catch may have affected Chopra, Yuvraj miscues a pull and the ball lands safe in the region of deep midwicket, Chopra runs across from deep square and over runs it and the ball rolls to the boundary
he shapes to punch but checks his stroke and the ball lobs towards cover
turned to midwicket
gets a leading edge to cover
makes room and carves it wide of third man

Dropped That too a collision! Yuvraj gets a thick too edge off a slog sweep, Ganguly runs back from midwicket, Chopra runs forward from deep square, both converge towards it, Chopra gets a hand to it but the ball slips out of his hand as Ganguly collides with him, the captain is furious. He may have called for the catch first, who knows

full and slanted on the pads, he works it with a flick of the wrists and the ball races away towards long leg, Gul sfrom fine leg slides and deflects it to Mendis who runs across from deep square leg, it appeared as if Mendis jumped across the rope with the ball in hand, the third umpire has a look and surprisingly gives it three runs
fires in a yorker outside off, he digs it out to Hussey at cover
the slower ball, it's actually a low full toss and Yuvraj fails to put it away as the under edge rolls to the keeper
drags a full length delivery from outside off and places it to midwicket
hits a good length outside off, he pushes it across the line to mid-on

leg before! Pitches in line of offstump, the ball carries on with the angle, Sanga tries to work it across the line but he misses, the ball hits him on the pads and Steve Davis is convinced, replays suggested the ball may have missed the offstump
pushes a full length ball towards cover, Shukla gets a hand to it on the dive but the ball slips past him
he's unstoppable! Gul pitches it up on middle and leg, he walks across his stumps and pulls it off the front foot and deposits the ball over deep square leg
good comeback, he fires in the yorker and Sanga jams it onto his boot
bangs it in short, Sanga picks the length early, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it over midwicket
makes room but fails to put away a full delivery, he places it to extra cover
shot! Hussey gives it a lot of flight on middle and off, he stays at the crease and clubs it over the bowler's head, the ball lands half a dozen rows back
plays a checked drive towards cover
bowls this much flatter, he lofts it towards long-on
punches a low full toss hard to long-on
fired on the pads, he works it thrugh the line to long-on
flighted outside off, Sanga makes room and lofts it inside out and carves it over extra cover, that brings up yet another fifty for him
defended back to the bowler on the front foot, we've hardly seen any turn from Mendis today
worked off the pads to the on side

the bowling change down the trick! Mendis delivers it from a few inches behind the popping crease and holds the length back, Marsh gives him the charge, lofts over the infield but ends up sending it down Chopra's throat at long-on
slogs it across the line and keeps it along the turf to long-on
steps down the track to smother the spin, he punches it to long-off
attempts a slog sweep, he mistimes it towards square leg
driven hard  back to the bowler
Flighted on middle and off, Marsh makes room, takes a couple of paces down the track and lofts it high over long-on
Pushed to deep extra cover
Full on middle, he works it to the on side
steps down the track, Hussey fires in the yorker and he hits it along the turf to the on side
pitched up outside the offstump, Marsh gets in position for the slog sweep early and carves it over midwicket, it was as if Marsh had it all planned in his mind
just short of a length, he drags this from outside off and pulls it to Ganguly at deep midwicket
makes room and slogs a full delivery down the ground to long-on, Mendis picks it up
fullish outside off, he pushes it towards long-off
shapes to punch it through the line to long-on but he gets an inside edge to the on side
misfield! Sanga punches a full toss showing the full face of the bat towards long-on, Gul slides and lets it slip past his legs
gives the charge and pushes it down to the deep on the on side
fails to put away a low full toss, Hussey fields off his own bowling
nudges it with the angle past midwicket
gives it a lot of air outside off, he stays at the crease, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts over long-on
tucked away towards square leg
sweeps from wide outside the offstump and places it to fine leg
fullish outside off, he drives just across the line to long-on
Shukla deflects another straight drive off his boot and the ball trickles to the offside
seizes a short of a length delivery and pulls it to deep midwicket
moves across his stumps early and improvises brilliantly, he drags it from middle and off and paddles it wide of short fine leg
just slides down the legside, he tries to glance but misses
drives hard back to the bowler and he deflects it off his boot, the ball hits the non striker
fullish outside offhe pushes it towards mid-off
opens the face of the bat and angles it softly towards short third man, good over by Hussey
once again he drives a full delivery straight to extra cover
full and wide outside off, he drives straight to extra cover
mows across the line early and mistimes it to the on side
gives it plenty of air outside off, Sangakkara fails to time his loft well but he just manages to clear mid-off, Ganguly runs backwards but he can't get to it
shot! That was fractionally short of a length and wide outside off, he gets back at the crease and punches it off the 'V' crisply past extra cover, all timing
the slower ball, he checks his stroke and angles it gently towards point
tries to punch it wide of the covers but he ends up mistiming it to extra cover
slightly short of a length and he swivels and pulls past square leg, Mendis runs across from deep square leg to pick it up
he drags a full and wide delivery from outside the offstump and places it to long-on
directs the ball on the pads and Sanga makes him pay by flicking it with intent past midwicket, that shot had power
beaten! Good comeback by Ishant, he just slants it across the left hander and Marsh is all at sea whether to play or leave it
Shuffles across his stumps and whips it towards midwicket
pitches it up outside the line of the offstump, Sanga gets behind the line and lofts it way over mid-off
charges down the track to launch it over the on side but he swings and misses, that wasnt far from the legstump
hits a good length outside off, he pushes it towards cover
slightly back of a length, he drags that from middle and off, rolls his wrists and flicks it elegantly wide of square leg, the timing was excellent
shot of the day so far! He takes a few paces down the pitch, Mendis holds the length back but Marsh adjusts well by punching it off the full face of the bat and beating mid-off comfortably
pushes it to mid-on on the walk and sets off for a quick run
holds the length back on seeing him give the charge, he taps it back to the bowler
comes on straight, he punches it to mid-off
no turn, he punches it wide of cover
lands it on a full length on offstump, he lofts through the line off the meat of the bat and clears mid-off
slices it hard towards backward point and Hussey makes an athletic save, the batsmen scamper through for the run and Chopra's throw nearly hits the stumps at the batsman's end
follows it up with the slower ball, Marsh just opens the face of the bat and angles it down to cover
follows the movement outside the offstump and he carves it over point and down to third man, Mendis mops it up
taps it to mid-off
Slants it across the left hander, he shoulders arms
Follows it up with a poor delivery down the leg side, Sanga tries to pull but he misses

leg before! Gul pitches it on middle and off on a good length and the ball comes in with the angle, Hopes plays across the line but the ball skids through and hits him in line with middle and leg, umpire Shivram is convinced
slides on the pads, he's keeping it on a fullish length, Hopes works it wide of midwicket
fullish in length outside off and he works it wide of cover
the straighter one this time, marsh defends again
this one comes in, Marsh decides to defend it away
takes a couple paces down the track and adjusts his stroke as the ball lands on a  good length, bit of a googly
lands it on the half volley outside leg and he turns it to deep midwicket, no turn there

Dropped: That's a tough one though, Hopes latches onto a delivery short and wide outside off, he tries to carve it over third man but the ball dips on Gul as he runs across to his right to catch it, the ball just slips out of his hand on the dive
he errs again by sliding on the pads, it's a half volley for Hopes as he whips it wide of square leg, that raced away
I spoke too soon! Ishant loses his line and slides it so wide down the legside that even two wicketkeepers couldn't have stopped it
squares him up with a ball that cuts back in, Marsh adjusts well and tucks it away to the on side, good start by Ishant
worked off the pads towards midwicket and Hopes dives at the crease, Ganguly's throw was just wide of the stumps
misfield! Hopes sizes up to a short of a length ball, gets on top of the bounce and plays a flat-batted biff towards Shukla at mid-off and he lets it slip through his legs
lands it just outside the line off off and gets it to cut back in, Hopes gets behind the line and pushes it towards cover
strays a bit on the pads, he shuffles and works it wide off his pads to the on side
bangs it in short and the ball just slides wide of the legstump after Hopes backs out of the stroke, not quite wide enough to be called
bowls it in line with the stumps and Marsh does well to get his bat down and tap it softly in front of mid-off to set off for a quick single
good comeback by Gul as he just slants it across the left hander and beats him, Marsh fishes outside the offstump
bangs it slightly short and wide down the legside, he tries to pull but misses
just fractionally wide outside off and he times it well as he slices past backward point, Ishant does really well to slide to his right and cut it off before the rope
bowls it full and wide and he really has to stretch out to fetch that, he gets an under edge past the keeper
and he's done it! Pathan fires it on the blockhole, Ganguly digs it out to the offside and sets off for the single to seal the win
wow! Pathan overpitches outside off, Ganguly makes just a bit of room, lofts through the line and effortlessly  carts it over the bowlers head
charges down the track, a high full toss, he pulls just over Sreesanth at midwicket, that was not called a no ball as he was well out of his crease
smart move so far! Pathan bowls from back of the crease, slides on the pads, Ganguly shuffles and whips it high over deep square leg
he creams a full delivery to long-off, Ganguly wants to farm the strike and he refuses the single
the low full toss swinging away, Ganguly makes room and creams it hard to the offside, Yuvraj does well to cut that off at extra cover, that saves 3 runs for Punjab
Ganguly suddenly eases the pressure! VRV errs by slanting it on his pads, he makes room and whips it wide of midwicket, the timing was good enough

Punjab claw back! He bowls it on a good length with good pace, Gul stays at the crease for the loft, he scoops it high in the air but doesn't get the desired elevation, Powar takes it easily at long-off
fires it on the blockhole outside off again, this time he pushes it firmly to long-off, only a single this time
fires it on the blockhole outside off, he mows it across the line to long-on, they scamper for a couple
Sreesanth lets it slip out early and the ball slides on the pads, he shuffles just a touch and the ball clips his pads and beats the keeper and fine leg comfortably
Gul is really justifying his No.8 slot here! Sreesanth lands his slower ball on the half volley, he slogs across the line and carts it high over cow corner, super shot
bangs it in short, Gil stays at the crease and clubs it across the line, he picks his spot well as there is nobody patrolling deep square leg to cut it off
excellent slower ball again, Gul makes room but is foxed by the legcutter outside off, there was nothing he could do about that
good variation by Sreesanth as he bowls the slow bouncer, he makes room, plays too early and pulls it softly to short fine leg
Sreesanth comes back for a new spell, he lofts it high over mid-off but the ball just falls short of long-off
gets on his knee early and sweeps it square, Sreesanth picks it up
this one skids on him quick, he just manages to cover the line and fend it off, the ball nearly trickled on the stumps
pushes it flatter, outside off, he makes room and places it just wide of short third man
make that 28 off 5 balls! Chawla flights it on middle and leg, he stays at the crease and slog sweeps it over midwicket
it gets better! Chawla flights it outside leg, he gets on his knee and sweeps it fine , that's 22 off four 4 balls
that's three in a row! Flighted on middle and leg, he steps down the track and lauches him over long-on, the crowd's woken up finally!
and another! Hopes pitches it up on middle and leg, Gul lofts through the line and carts it over long-on

going, going! Hopes thuds it in short, Gul swivels early for the  hook and though he takes his eyes off the ball at the point of contact, he gets enough distance to send the ball back many rows back over fine leg
stays back and punches it past the bowler, Ganguly sets off, turns back, jayawardene's under arm flick just misses the stumps and a direct hit would have been curtains for Ganguly

Hopes thuds it in short and gets it to angle in towards the right hander, Chopra goes for the pull too early and he gets a thin edge off the back of the bat, Sangakkara dives forward and gloves it easily
makes room, he fails to squeeze a full and wide delivery past point
pitches it on a good length on offstump, he pushes it to long-on to give Ganguly the strike
nudged off the pads to the on side for a single
opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man

Saha gives him the charge again to launch him downtown, Chawla gives it extra flight and holds the length back a little shorter, Saha fails to go through with the loft, Pathan runs forward from long-on to take the skier
this one comes on straight, he tucks it to the on side
gives him the charge and lofts it over mid-on, luckily for him the ball just falls short of Pathan
takes the attack to Chawla by stepping down the track and whipping it against the turn over midwicket
overpitches outside the offstump, he fails to put away the half volley, Yuvraj at extra cover picks it up
fullish outside the offstump, he gets forward and pushes it wide of cover
pitched outside off, he steers it to point
bangs it in short, it sits up nicely for Ganguly who has the time to rock back and pull just over long-on's reach
now Ganguly walks across to paddle it away, Hopes fires it outside off, Ganguly can only push it back to the bowler
he shuffles across to paddle scoop it but he gets his direction wrong, the ball lands well in front of deep square leg
gets forward and pushes it through the line to long-off, Pathan ends an impressive over, just 2 off it
cramps him for room, he steers it softly in front of point but Marsh is alert as ever, another dot ball
digs out a yorker length ball to mid-off, Yuvraj dives forward and under-arms the throw towards the stumps and misses
leans forward for the drive early and he neatly chips it on the full back to the bowler
slightly short of a length, he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
bowls the slow offcutter, opens the face of the bat and slices it towards cover
lands it outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers it to Marsh at point
lovely ball from VRV as he gets it to nip back sharply and slice him in half, the ball went past the daylight between bat and pad
shuffles a little and VRV follows him by bowling a yorker outside off, he drags it across the line and places the ball to the on side
fullish outside off, he drives to cover
classic! VRV gives him just a bit of width outside off, he rocks back and caresses it wide of backward point, that's vintage Ganguly
the slower ball slides really wide down the legside
just short of a good length on middle and off, he pushes it softly in front of cover and sets off
full outside off, he drives towards cover
gets on his knee and drags that from outside off, VRV boots it away just in front of the deep square leg rope
beats him on the offdrive
appeal for a leg before! It strikes him on the pads just outside the line of offstump as he gets forward to defend
flighted outside off, pushed to the offside
flighted on middle, he tucks it to midwicket
almost another wicket! He gets the ball to nip back in, he's gets forward to defend but the ball flies off the inside edge and just misses the stumps and runs to fine leg

cartwheel! Shulka makes just a bit of room outside his legstump to improvise, VRV bangs it on a good length in line of legstump and the ball holds its line, Shukla tries to work it to the on side but leaves a big gap between bat and pad, the legstump goes back nearly halfway through to the keeper, that's a magnificent sight for any fast bowler or for that matter any of us
rocks back at the crease and nudges it close to the pads to the on side
he bowls the slower ball and slides just wide down the legside, VRV reckoned the ball brushed Ganguly before reaching the keeper
tucks him up for room outside off, he rocks back at the crease and steers it to cover
opens the face of the bat late and glides it down to third man
gets back at the crease and punches to the offside for a single
take that! Chawla flights it outside off and overpitches, Shukla slams it over extra cover, the ball disappeared in a flash
he gets down ton sweep early, the ball is flighted very slowly and it strikes him on the pads outside the line of offstump
excellent stuff from Chawla! Hussey gives him the charge again, he cleverly holds the length back and bowls the googly, Hussey swings and misses and the ball flattens the middle stump

very streaky! Hussey steps down the track but fails to get to the pitch of the ball, another under edge misses the stumps and Srivastava runs backwards from short fine leg and does well to pull it back before the rope
flighted on off and middle, he defends on the front foot
lands on a good length and holds its line, he punches to mid-off
streaky but he'll take it, he drives away from his body and the thick under edge trickles past the stumps and beats the keeper in a flash, there's nobody at fine leg to cut it off
he makes room and punches a good length delivery crisply off the meat of the bat, a good looking stroke for nothing as he ends up placing it straight to mid-off
gets the ball to angle into the right hander, Hussey settles for a punch straight to point
the fuller ball, he leans forward and scoops it over mid-off, the ball lands well short of Sreesanth in the deep
shuffles across his stumps and slices it hard along the turf, Marsh makes an athletic save diving to his right and Jayawardene is there to back him up, such professionalism in the fielding, awesome
hits a good length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and angles it to point
gets forward to drive but plays an inside out stroke  back to the bowler
steps down the track, checks his stroke and pushes it back to the bowler
leans forward and drives to the on side, he releases the handle after playing the shot
flighted on middle and off, he leans forward and works it wide to square leg
pitches outside off, he punches with the turn to cover
flights it very slowly, Ganguly waits for it and decides to defend on the front foot
stand and deliver! The ball is fractionally short and the away swing gives Hussey enough room to rock back and punch that firmly past cover, nobody moved, it just scorched along the turf
hits a good length outside off at a good pace, he opens the face of the bat late and dabs it to third man
could have had him! Sreesanth gets it to swing in sharply rather late, Hussey tries to push it towards mid-off but doesn't fully cover the swing, the inside edge rolls to the on side

on a hat-trick! Sreesanth pitches it on a good length on off and middle, the ball comes in slightly with the angle and catches Das on the forward prod, Steve Davis reckons that would have hit the legstump

Sreesanth bowls another slower ball, the legcutter, Butt gets on his knee to slog the full length ball over the on side, he fails to get the elevation and places it straight to Srivastava at short midwicket
the slower ball, he has a wild swing and misses it completely, the ball dips before reaching Sanga
backs away early, meets the pitch of the ball and lofts,  he gets just enough elevation to clear mid-on who makes a brave attempt to pull off a one handed blinder
down the legside
makes room and places it to cover
gives him the charge and misses, possible stumping chance as the ball rolls off the keepers pads
gives it plenty of flight, he steps down the track and lofts it high over the bowler's head, the ball swirls in the air for ages before landing just after the rope
makes room to slice it through off, the ball straightens, he punches it to cover
sprays it full and wide outside off, he gives himself width to free his arms and he succeeds in putting it away by carving it over backward point, third man had no chance
makes room to cream a full delivery across the line to the on side but he gets a thin inside edge which misses the stumps and beats the keeper
full and wide outside off, Ganguly executes another cover drive and still can't get it past Chawla at extra cover who slides to his left to intercept it
overpitched outside off, that deserved to be hit, Ganguly drives it crisply along the turf but Chawla does well to slide to his right and cut it off, that was a certain boundary
pitches on a fullish length outside off, he tries to cream it past the infield on the offside but fails to beat mid-off
hits a good length wide outside off, he makes room and punches it hard down to mid-off
pitches outside off, he opens the face of the bat and angles it down to third man
excellent shot! Pathan misdirects the offcutter wide outside off, Butt gets on his knee and plays a spanking square drive past cover
fullish on middle and off, he defends back to the bowler off the full face of the bat
slides down the legside and he whips it with ease off his pads, he rolls his wrists well and places it wide of deep square leg
makes room and advances down the track to club it past the bowler but he swings and misses
taps it away towards point
there we have a Butt special as he allows the ball come onto the face and then angles it to third man for a single. A little more timing would have helped
fuller on the off stump. Butt, uncertain of the swing covers the line and defends on the frontfoot
Sreesanth also troubling batsmen with swing as he squares up Butt with an away moving delivery and induces the outside edge which does not carry to the slips
on the good length area again as Butt comes forward and defends
frustration there for Sreesanth as everything goes according to the plan but for the thin edge that just eludes the diving keeper
starts off  with a good length delivery on the middle stump, Butt flicks it to midwicket
outside the off stump, Ganguly moves across a touch and defends it on the backfoot. Eventful over
thats vintage Ganguly as he comes forward and splits the gap at cover for a magnificent boundary
Pathan tests him out with a short delivery as Ganguly pulls it to deep midwicket for a boundary
Ganguly is troubled by the swing in air as Pathan is troubling him with fuller deliveries
Ganguly gets a full delivery first up as he pushes at it a tad uncomfortably to midwicket
fuller in length outside the off stump, Butt comes forward and pushes it to mid off for a single
opening ball blues there for Pathan there as he fires one down the leg side and it is a wide
